summary: Discussion-sourced snapshot: vendor product launches (Anthropic, DeepSeek, Grok) and rising operator concerns (memory safety, MCP adoption, sandbox/security bugs). Mix of Bluesky/HN reports and GH issue traces; follow vendor changelogs and repo corroboration. | Vendor-only sweep: multiple mainstream agent product updates (Anthropic Opus 5, Vercel AI Gateway, Mistral Studio/Vibe), JetBrains IDE agent workflows and fixes, and several infra primitives (Modal/Daytona sandboxes, DeepSeek isolation). Missing independent social/operator reports for field validation. | Deduplicated GitHub-OSS signals: multiple high-traction agent frameworks and vendor releases (GitHub, Anthropic, Google, Vercel, Dify, mem0); several infra primitives (MCP servers, gateways, circuit-breakers) and a few operator-facing workflows (CoDev, Peekaboo). Missing social operator reports for field adoption and incident signals. | Package-only shard: many agent-focused libs, VS Code extensions, MCP tooling, sandboxes, and security detectors. Strong vendor signals (OpenAI, Notion, Vercel); few social/operator reports in this shard — follow-up needed for field adoption.
